To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the evolutionary history of life on earth is one of the increasing cooperation and cohesion of groups of organisms, and that the processes of biological evolution have shaped the sociality of human beings.

(1) the evolution of biological cooperation provides an important foundation for the analysis of human social behavior and (2) the evolution of cooperation in biology is a process of increasing group cohesion.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the biological foundations of cooperation have shaped human sociality.
the evolutionary foundations of cooperation and group cohesion in humans.
understanding the biological foundations of human sociality.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
biology provides a foundation for the understanding of human cooperation and sociality, but that foundation is not the whole story.
biological evolution provides both a conceptual and a historical foundation for the understanding of human sociality.
biology provides a foundation for understanding cooperation and group cohesion in humans.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
biological evolution has shaped human behavior in many ways that are often overlooked in the social sciences.
we have been trying to understand human behavior by looking at the biological roots of human cooperation and sociality.
we are trying to understand the evolutionary foundations of cooperation and group cohesion in biology and in humans.
The main takeaway from our work is that
human behavior is not fundamentally distinct from the behavior of other animals.
the evolutionary foundations of cooperation are the same for both humans and other animals.
the biological evolution of cooperation has produced a set of social institutions that can serve as a foundation for the analysis of human social life.
